Name: PixelDew Valley
Author: spritelessG
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Pixel Dungeon has some interesting seeds. And it's open source ([url=https://github.com/watabou/pixel-dungeon/blob/master/LICENSE.txt]GNU General Public License v3.0[/url]). And no one has done this already, that's wild.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Find plants inside dungeons, and either eat them right away because buffs or sling them right away because explosions or bring them home and put them in seedmaker and grow so many of them yaaaay![/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Changes from Pixel Dungeon gameplay:[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]The way the crops work is sometimes backwards from Pixel Dungeon. They are very different games! Stardew's farmer is more agile compared to the monsters in the mines, than Pixel Dungeon's adventurer is to the monsters in The Pixel Dungeon. The Farmer will leave the mines and come back, so can grow the magic herbs of the dungeon at home, while The Adventurer does not simply leave Pixel Dungeon without the Amulet of Yendor[/size][/color]

Future features/feature creep demons:
Add recipes - Pixel Dungeon has a few food items.
Add personalized likes and dislikes - I've only done context tags
Add some Pixel Dungeon weapons
Add more items from Darkest/Shattered Pixel Dungeon forks.
Add hats, clothing.
Add compatability for Stardew Survival Project. If you eat an Icecap you should cool down!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires Content Patcher and Item Extensions to work[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Without Slingshot Framework all the items will be ordinary vegetables in your slingshot, taking away 1/2 the fun[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Without Buff Framework regeneration buffs won't work.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [url=https://watabou.itch.io/]Watabou [/url]for making [url=https://watabou.itch.io/pixel-dungeon]Pixel Dungeon [/url]to begin with! I am using some of the sprites from his game, and added some sprites with plants that aren't fully grown.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Krobus server for encouragement and answering my Stardew modding questions.[/color][/size]

License:
Pixel Dungeon is released under [url=https://github.com/watabou/pixel-dungeon/blob/master/LICENSE.txt]GNU General Public License v3.0[/url] and so is this mod. That means you can make forks or replacements or additions to this mod without asking, but you have to link back (attribute), release the code (open source), use the same license (copyleft), and state what changes you make. 

For my part, I have taken ideas and pixel art from Pixel Dungeon and created a bunch of json code so Stardew Valley can use it. I made a few recolors of the seed bag. I created a few inbetween frames for partially grown plants. If someone wants to have a fork of Pixel Dungeon in which plants take more than a tick to grow, then they could use these sprites.
